arabic_text: يَامَنْ لاَ يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ أَنْبَآءُ الْمُتَظَلِّمِينَ
transliteration: yaman laa yakhfaa ʿalayhi anbaau almutazallimīn
english_text: O He from whom is not concealed news of the aggrieved!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يَحْتَاجُ فِي قِصَصِهِمْ إلَى شَهَادَاتِ الشَّاهِدِينَ
transliteration: wayā man lā yahtāju fī qiṣāṣihim ilā shahādāt al-shāhidīn
english_text: O He who has no need to be told about them by the witnessing of the witnesses!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ قَرُبَتْ نُصْرَتُهُ مِنَ الْمَظْلُومِينَ
transliteration: wa yā man qarubat nuṣratuhu min al-maẓlūmīn
english_text: O He who whose help is near to the wronged!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ بَعُدَ عَوْنُهُ عَنِ الظَّالِمِينَ قَدْ عَلِمْتَ يَا إلهِي مَا نالَنِي مِنْ [فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَن] مِمَّا حَظَرْتَ وَانْتَهَكَهُ مِنّي مِمَّا حَجَزْتَ عَلَيْهِ بَطَراً فِي نِعْمَتِكَ عِنْدَهُ وَاغْتِرَاراً بِنَكِيرِكَ عَلَيْهِ
transliteration: waya man baʿuda ʿawnuhu ʿani alẓẓalimīna qad ʿalimta yā ilāhī mā nālanī min [fulānin bin fulān] mimmā ḥaẓarta wa-antahakahu minni mimma hajazta ʿalayhi bataraan fi niʿmatika ʿindahu wa-ightiraran binakirika ʿalayhi
english_text: O He whose aid is far from the wrongdoers! Thou knowest, my God, how so-and-so, son of so-and-so, has harmed me in that which Thou hast forbidden, and how he has violated me in that which Thou hast prohibited, showing thereby ingratitude toward Thy favour upon him and delusion concerning what Thou hast denied him.

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَخُذْ ظَالِمِي وَعَدُوِّي عَنْ ظُلْمِي بِقُوَّتِكَ وَافْلُلْ حَدَّهُ عَنِّي بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَاجْعَلْ لَهُ شُغْلاً فِيَما يَلِيهِ وَعَجْزاً عَمَّا يُناوِيْهِ
transliteration: allāhumma faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wakhudh ẓalimī wa ʿaduwwī ʿan ẓulmī biquwwatika wa aflul haddahu anni bi qudratika wa aj'al lahu.. shughlan fiyama yaleehi wa'ajzan 'amma yunawihi
english_text: O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household, keep my wrongdoing enemy from wronging me through Thy strength, blunt his blade toward me through Thy power, and assign to him a diversion in that which is close to him and the inability to reach his enemy!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَلاَ تُسَوِّغْ لَهُ ظُلْمِي وَأَحْسِنْ عَلَيْـهِ عَوْنِي، وَاعْصِمْنِي مِنْ مِثْـلِ أَفْعَالِهِ، وَلا تَجْعَلْنِي فِي مِثْلِ حَالِهِ.
transliteration: allāhumma wa ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa lā tusawwigh lahū ẓulmī wa aḥsin ʿalayhi ʿawnī waʿṣimnī min mithli afʿālihi, wa lā tajʿalnī fī mithli ḥālihī
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, let the wrongdoer not find it easy to wrong me, give me good help against him, preserve me from the like of his acts, and place me not in the like of his situation!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ ، وَأَعِدْنِي عَلَيْهِ عَدْوى حَاضِرَةً تَكُونُ مِنْ غَيْظِي بِهِ شِفَاءً، وَمِنْ حَنَقِي عَلَيْهِ وَفَاءً.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa'a`idni `alayhi `adwaa hadiratan takunu min ghaythi shifa'an wa min ḥanaqī ʿalayhi wafāʾan
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, and assist me with an immediate assistance that will heal my rage toward him and redeem my fury toward him!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَعَوِّضْنِي مِنْ ظُلْمِهِ لِي عَفْوَكَ، وَأَبْدِلْنِي بِسُوْءِ صنِيعِهِ بِيْ رَحْمَتَكَ، فَكُلُّ مَكْرُوه جَلَلٌ دُونَ سَخَطِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih waʿawwidhni min ẓulmihī liyaʿfwaka wa 'abdilnī bi-sū'i sanīʿihi bī raḥmataka fakullu makruh jallalun dunaa sakhatika
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, compensate me for his wronging me with Thy pardon and replace his evil action toward me with Thy mercy, for every detested thing less than Thy anger is slight

transliteration: wa kullu murzi'ah sawa'un ma'a mawjidatika
english_text: and every disaster next to Thy rancour indifferent!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا كَـرَّهْتَ إلَيَّ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ فَقِنِي مِنْ أَنْ أُظْلَمَ.
transliteration: allāhumma fa-kamā karrat-i'ī ilayya an adhlima faqinī min an uzhlima
english_text: O God, just as Thou hast made me detest being wronged, so also protect me from doing wrong!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ أَشْكُو إلَى أَحَد سِوَاكَ، وَلاَ أَسْتَعِينُ بِحَاكِم غَيْرِكَ حَاشَاكَ
transliteration: allāhumma lā ashku ilā āḥadun siwāka wa lā astaʿīnu biḥākim ghayrika ḥāshāka
english_text: O God, I complain to no one but Thee, and I seek help from no ruler other than Thee - how could I?

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَصِلْ دُعَائِي بِالإِجَابَةِ، وَأَقْرِنْ شِكَايَتِي بِالتَّغْيِيرِ.
transliteration: fa ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih waṣil duʿāʾī bi-l-iǧābaẗi, wa-aqrin šikāyatī bi-t-taġyīr
english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household, join my supplication to response, and unite my complaint with change!

arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ لا تَفْتِنِّي بِالْقُنُوطِ مِنْ إنْصَافِكَ، وَلاَ تَفْتِنْـهُ بِالأَمْنِ مِنْ إنْكَارِكَ، فَيُصِرَّ عَلَى ظُلْمِي وَيُحَاضِرَنِي بِحَقِّيْ
transliteration: allāhumma lā taf'tinī bil-qunūṭi min inṣāfika walā tafitinhu bil-amni min inkārik fayuṣirru ʿalā ẓulmī wayuḥāḍirani bi-ḥaqqī
english_text: O God, tempt me not with despair of Thy just treatment and tempt him not with feeling secure from Thy disapproval, lest he persist in wronging me and constrain me in my rights.

arabic_text: وَعَرِّفْهُ عَمَّا قَلِيْل مَا أَوْعَدْتَ الظَّالِمِينَ، وَعَرِّفْنِي مَا وَعَدْتَ مِنْ إجَابَةِ الْمُضْطَرِّينَ.
transliteration: wa ʿarrifhu ʿammā qalīl mā awʿadt alẓālimīn waʿar-rif-ni mā waʿadt-a min ijābat-il-muḍṭar-rīn
english_text: Let him soon recognize what Thou hast promised the wrongdoers and let me recognize Thy promised response to the distressed!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَوَفِّقْنِي لِقَبُولِ مَا قَضَيْتَ لِيْ وَعَليَّ، وَرَضِّنِيْ بِمَا أَخَذْتَ لي وَمِنِّي وَاهْـدِنِي لِلَّتِيْ هِي أَقْوَمُ وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِمَا هُوَ أَسْلَمُ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa waffiqnī liqabūli mā qadhaīta lī wa ʿalayya wa raḍḍinī bimā akhaḏta lī waminnī waahdinii lillatii hiya aqwamu wastam`ilnii bimaa huwa aslamu
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, give me success in accepting Thy decrees for me and against me, make me pleased with what Thou takest for me and from me, guide me to that which is most upright and employ me in that which is safest!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ كَانَتِ الْخِيَرَةُ لِيْ عِنْدَكَ فِي تَأْخِيرِ الأَخْذِ لِي وَتَرْكِ الانْتِقَامِ مِمَّنْ ظَلَمَنِيْ إلَى يَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ وَمَجْمَعِ الْخَصْمِ، فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa in kānatil-khayratu lī ʿindaka fī taʾkhīr al-ʾakhḏi lī wa tarik al-intiqām mimman ẓalamani ila yawmi al-faṣli wa majmaʿi al-khaṣm faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih
english_text: O God, if the best for me with Thee lies in delaying the taking to task for my sake of him who has wronged me and in refraining from vengeance toward him until the Day of Decision and the Gathering of Disputants, then bless Muhammad and his Household,

arabic_text: وَأَيِّدْنِي مِنْكَ بِنِيَّة صَادِقَة وَصَبْر دَائِم، وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ سُوءِ الرَّغْبَةِ، وَهَلَعِ أَهْلِ الْحِرْصِ، وَصَوِّرْ فِي قَلْبِي مِثَالَ مَا ادَّخَـرْتَ لِي مِنْ ثَوَابِـكَ، وَأَعْدَدْتَ لِخَصْمِي مِنْ جَزَائِكَ وَعِقَابِكَ ،
transliteration: waʾayyidnī minka binīyat ṣādiqah wa ṣabr dāʾim wa'a'ithni min su'i al-raghbah, wa hala'i ahl al-hirshe wa ṣawwir fī qalbī mithāla mā addakhartalī min thawābika wa aʿdadta li-khasmī min jazāʾika wa ʿiqābika
english_text: strengthen me from Thee with true intention and lasting patience, give me refuge from evil desire and the impatience of the greedy and form in my heart the image of Thy reward which Thou hast stored away for me and the repayment and punishment

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ سَبَباً لِقَنَاعَتِي بِمَا قَضَيْتَ ، وَثِقَتِي بِمَا تَخَيَّرْتَ، آمِينَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ ،
transliteration: wa'aj'al dhalika sababan li-qana'ati bima qadayta waṯiqatī bimā takhayyar-ta, āmīn rabba al-'ālamīn
english_text: which Thou has prepared for my disputant! Make this a cause of my contentment with what Thou hast decreed and my trust in what Thou hast chosen! Amen, Lord of the worlds!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ .
transliteration: 'innaka dhū al-faḍli al-'aẓīm, wa 'anta 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr
english_text: Thou art of bounty abounding and Thou art powerful over everything.
